issue.title: Spark S0-S9: backend completion — canonical exposure boundary, activity family, desk/window/recorder lineage, scan-rank boundary, exact contract identity
issue.body:
## What this is

Revision-10 backend completion track (Spark). Frontend is untouched and
deliberately deferred; **no UI is certified by this PR**.

Base `main` 605aca8a → head 45dad9ab. No force push, no history rewrite,
no skipped hooks, no credential change, nothing deployed or activated.

## The five production changes

**Canonical measurement boundary.** `resolve_multiplier` now rejects an
explicitly invalid multiplier (0 / negative / NaN / bool) instead of
silently defaulting it to 100, distinguishes absent / measured-zero /
unknown / quarantined, and surfaces alias disagreement rather than taking
whichever field appears first. Booleans are rejected as measurements.

**The activity family is now four distinct metrics.** Session volume
(Σ c·u·V) stays backward compatible; session volume × delta
(Σ c·u·V·|δ|) is a separately registered metric with its own grid twin.
They are different quantities over different populations and are never
substituted. The mounted UI still labels the plain activity grid
"Session vol × Δ" — that label migration is explicit deferred UI work.

**Window activity is governed.** A comparability gate (ticker, provider,
scope, formula, session, source ordering — all fail-closed) plus the live
enrichment kernel. Cross-symbol or session-rolled windows now return a
reason instead of a number.

**Recorder health separates the store from the job.** Durable-vs-memory,
last capture, gaps and errors, with a disabled-by-default worker and
stop/recovery instructions. `absent` / `wired_off` / `active` are
distinct states; none of them is "needs time". Mounted on the real
`/api/solstice/recorder_health`.

**Exact contract identity for review.** New read-only
`GET /api/solstice/{ticker}/contract` resolves an explicit identity
(OSI, or strike+expiry+type) from a recorded snapshot. A wall midpoint or
first expiry is refused with a reason, never substituted.

## Verification (all at the merged head)

- `pytest tests/solstice` → 426 passed
- `pytest tests/routes` + Eastern-clock + wall-desk → 380 passed
- `ruff check .` → clean · `truth_audit.sh` → 226 passed / 0 failed
- `bandit --severity-level medium` → exit 0
- py3.12 syntax check on every changed module

The full suite was **not** re-run end-to-end at this head; the matrix
records exactly what was run and what was inferred. Coverage 68.03% was
measured pre-resweep against a 60% gate.

## Self-review found real defects, and they are fixed

A second adversarial pass over this branch's own new code found and closed
eleven, each pinned by a test that fails without the fix. The most
serious: the window comparability gate was **fail-open**, so a window with
no declared ticker returned `window_net = 500.0`. Also fixed: an unbounded
cache, cache hits carrying no cache time, hits reporting a stale cursor as
live, the US DST rule silently an hour wrong for pre-2007 instants, uncounted
wall exclusions, published values with no population, unvalidated weight
overrides, a provider failure that 500'd a route, and a cached-failure
outage introduced by that last fix.

One regression was mine: the DST hardening broke
`test_live_window_dst_fallback.py`. The test was right and the narrowing was
reverted, not the test.

## Not touched / not claimed

- `backend/routes/flowseeker.py`, TideHunterPro: **unmodified**.
- No dealer inventory, aggressor side, or calibrated probability anywhere.
- DUO/DVO remain experimental helpers, unwired, pending a dimensional
  decision on their units.
- ML unification deferred; no model artifacts, thresholds or frozen
  inference paths changed.

## Known open (not this PR)

- The lone full-suite teardown error is a credential-conditional
  offline-guard defect in `test_agentfield_hub.py` (R10-10). Invisible to
  CI because CI has no API key. Exoneration evidence is in
  `.planning/INTEGRATION_SPARK_S0_S9.md`.
- The three unpushed commits that were on local `main` turned out to be the
  source branch of the already-merged #86, so `main` was reconciled to
  `origin/main` first; that reconcile changed no content (tree diff empty).

issue.title: feat(solstice-r13): authoritative next-listed and same-wall replay research
issue.body:
# Solstice single-owner final checkpoint — HOLD, not merged

- **Base/main:** `9a6c02954557922e9b0d73d6011daf7430f72c16` (PR90 merge, unchanged).
- **Published HEAD:** `c9c02750295426954131226b29e6aa88d6334d24`.
- **Branch:** `solstice/zed-r13`; PR91 remains draft. Implementation commit: `cffa31d0e1dea4a9beff47dc5b024667edc5f38b`; final commit is evidence/checkpoint only.
- **Owner:** Zed / GPT-6.1-Sol only; no spawned agents, paid models or retired lane imports.

## Changed behavior

Server-owned Next listed selects one actual returned date within the declared 30-day exchange-date bound, with distinct cache/query/snapshot/record identity and an unavailable empty state. It is a structural date scope, not a next-tradable-contract selector; it never populates 0DTE with a future date. Recorded Triad scope restores without a duplicate fetch.

Lodestar resolves same-wall adjusted surfaces and recorded-only GEX replay from authoritative observations. Missing/invalid delta, invalid multiplier, partial contributions and measured zero retain their meanings. Replay does not read live substitutes, create live-history watches or invoke a model. Unknown contract population remains unknown, not zero. Exact-contract/window/non-GEX replay and incomplete older records remain explicitly unavailable; the read-only exact-contract drawer is preserved.

Two real browser regressions were red-tested and repaired: responsive pruning reopened a dismissed inspector, and native-zoom short-height allocation collapsed the matrix to 4px. Repeat-selection dismissal, familiar continuous matrix/Profile/compact sidebar/GEX-VEX-Charm tabs and independent-symbol maps are preserved. Raw remains the wall anchor; adjustments supply context at that same wall.

## Exact-head results

| Gate | Actual result at published HEAD |
| --- | --- |
| [CI/CD 36902598206](https://github.com/odaialdajani/floww-2/actions/runs/36902598206) | backend-tests SUCCESS: 6983 passed, 38 skipped, coverage 69.17%; frontend-build SUCCESS: 120 suites/1022 tests and production build passed |
| [lint 36902598182](https://github.com/odaialdajani/floww-2/actions/runs/36902598182) | SUCCESS, including Ruff, silent-exception and API-documentation gates |
| Local offline backend, Python 3.14.6 | 6870 passed, 37 existing skips; coverage 68.38%; external transports denied. Legitimate loopback transport modules excluded from this guard and separately passed 26 checks |
| Local frontend, Node 24.14.1 | 120 suites/1022 tests; production build passed |
| Local audits | Ruff clean; silent gate 344 files; API docs current at 373 paths; Bandit medium gate passed; truth audit 226 passed/0 failed; whitespace clean |
| Protected boundary | All 71 manifest paths byte-identical to base, including accepted MarketCoverage; frozen files unchanged |
| Docker | **UNVERIFIED / HOLD**: PR workflow skips docker-build; local default Docker context cannot reach `/var/run/docker.sock`. No daemon was started. Base-main Docker success is historical, not this head's acceptance |

CI ships/tests Python 3.12 and Node20. Local and CI totals describe their actual environments/commands; they are not conflated. No skips/xfails were added to hide failures.

## Browser evidence, separate from mocked tests

Fresh final-head source/build: `c9c02750295426954131226b29e6aa88d6334d24`. Source and compiled/served bundle hashes exactly match the published implementation receipt. Fixture SHA256: `9ae4ac44bcde416a9207be4a5bcbe69598d99fcfa0be9ae6a2142821a77caf9d`.

16 viewport shots (desktop/laptop/768/640/390 and native 200%), 60 resize iterations, linked raw/adjusted selection and scroll, Follow pause/resume, keyboard ownership and 21 signed-profile bars passed; zero page errors. Native Chromium page zoom uses `chrome.tabs.setZoom(2)`: viewport 1440→720, DPR1→2, CSS zoom1/pinch scale1. Matrix container is 246.5px with 35 paint-hit-tested cells, not merely mounted offscreen. Three blocked-font resource warnings are retained.

The committed receipt honestly identifies its tested source `cffa31d0`; fresh final-head rerun is retained locally under `.final-acceptance/`. Source/bundle/fixture equality binds the evidence-only checkpoint head; the older receipt was not relabeled. Historical R11 `72cdd943` receipt, 13 shots/60-resize trace and CSS-zoom caveat remain unchanged.

Loading dimensions, late-response cancellation, replay sequencing, safe Expand, exact-contract review and armed/live boundaries have mounted/mocked test coverage; this is not represented as actual live-browser transport or live-market acceptance. No illustrative graphics served as an implementation oracle. Browser-native zoom automation is not a manual browser-menu click or human comprehension study.

## Outstanding / next action

HOLD container acceptance. Verify the exact published head with an available Docker daemon or an approved CI run that actually executes the container gate. Do not merge or claim full completion before that gate is verified. Do not repeat already-green unchanged-source sweeps.

SPX entitlement, commissioning/capture activation, participant study and empirical live-session/strategy validation remain external. Unsupported Lodestar contexts stay unavailable. Engineering checks are not profitability validation.

Original dirty SPARK_STATE, watchdog kanban files, audit-fixes/cmd-c0 worktrees, backups, unrelated branches and accepted friend commits are preserved. Shared checkout stays on its old branch/head; implementation used an isolated worktree. No deployment, production restart, capture activation, live order, credential change or model retraining. Recovery state is `docs/solstice/ZED_STATE.md` in the continuation worktree; the local terminal receipt updates that recovery file without moving this tested HEAD.

Replay race (second presenter loses the guarded UPDATE), revoked-raced-against-consume, burned-on-broker-failure replay, store-broken mid-consume fail-closed, missing/malformed approval-id typed refusals. issue.title: Complete Solstice/Triad review, Public-only reads and bounded history admission
issue.body:
## Engineering changes
- Shared selection-owned Wall → Contract → Flow → Public review, readable map landmarks and truthful time-aligned chart gaps.
- Fail-closed Public-only provider boundaries; no silent alternate-provider or invented-zero fallback.
- Shared history reads have a total job deadline, cancellation-safe cleanup, and brief admission waiting instead of immediately dropping charts during slot contention.
- Local fact-only brief remains distinct from AI research, delivery, activation and orders.

## Verification
- Admission regression: eight failing cases before fix; focused seven-file sweep: 145 passed.
- Fresh full-backend coverage run and hosted checks are being executed against this head; earlier full tests are historical evidence, not current hosted acceptance.
- Pinned Ruff 0.15.22, CI-form Bandit, truth audit and make test passed locally.
- Compiled-browser review passed at 1440/1280/768/390 widths with next-listed selected explicitly after checking same-day state; no silent 0DTE substitution.

## Boundaries
No order, trading activation, capture activation, merge or deployment. Seven original owner holds and all 62 original obligations remain preserved. Historical source recovery and semantic branch review are in progress; green checks must not auto-close those obligations or claim complete historical data.
